text:
Rosa: Greenleaf just messaged AE  they need a 30m FedRAMP walk-through today to validate a migration milestone. Can we pivot the 3pm office hour?
Devon: I can take the demo if we compress slides. Which time do they want?
Greenleaf_CISO: (external) Morning PT preferred: 10:30 or 11:30. Need sandbox demo + checklist.
Aisha: 11:30 PT works for me for the compliance q&a. Tom, can you scrub the demo data?
Tom: Yep  give me 20m, will run the scrub per runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/sandbox-scrub and upload snapshot.
Rosa: @cs_scheduler_bot create new event "Greenleaf - FedRAMP sandbox review" at 11:30 PT, add Greenleaf_CISO and infra@greenleaf.com. Make it 35m.
cs_scheduler_bot: Creating event... ✅ Invite: https://cal.redwood.com/event/greenleaf-fedramp-1745129999 (11:30 PT / 18:30 UTC). Reminder 20m before.
Devon: Proposed agenda:
```
11:30 - 11:35 Goals & success criteria (Rosa)
11:35 - 11:50 Live demo: hosted baseline + KMS notes (Devon)
11:50 - 12:00 Compliance Q&A (Aisha)
12:00 - 12:05 Next steps & owners (Tom)
```
Tom: Snapshot link (will upload): https://internal.redwood/artifacts/greenleaf-snap-1745129999. PII removed via scrub-v2. I'll post when done.
Aisha: I'll prepare a 1-pager FedRAMP checklist and a short FAQ for on-prem vs hosted to paste in chat during call.
Rosa: Who owns post-call follow-ups and account health update? Need to capture renewal signals if they ask for long on-prem timelines.
Tom: I'll own follow-ups and create tickets for anything flagged as "renewal-risk".
Devon: I'll record demo and share timestamps for the clip.
Greenleaf_CISO: (external) Confirmed 11:30 PT. Appreciate the checklist and scrubbed sandbox.
Rosa: Pre-call sync at 11:00 DM huddle for handoffs. Aisha, Tom, Devon join?
Aisha: Yes, I'll join at 11:00.
Tom: Same. Uploading snapshot now.
cs_scheduler_bot: Event updated by Tom. Invites resent. Reminder scheduled: 20m and 5m before.
Tom: Snapshot uploaded: https://internal.redwood/artifacts/greenleaf-snap-1745129999 (scrubbed).
Rosa: Post-call pulse: 2 q's (Y/N blocker resolved, confidence 1-5). We'll append score to the account health page.
Devon: Note: add a slide showing KMS rotation cadence and HSM options so it's explicit during demo.
Aisha: If they ask about air-gapped deployment timelines, escalate to Solutions and mark renewal risk.
Rosa: Thanks team. See you at 11:00 pre-call. :thumbsup:
